verdict.rationale: Expensify documents SmartScan, which automatically reads merchant, date, total and currency from receipts in realtime. Ask Expensify AI lets users create, categorize and tag expenses in plain language, which covers part of the coding half of the story. A dated community report says categorization is wrong about 70% of the time, and others say SmartScan used human MTurk workers rather than pure automation. These reports undercut the depth of the AI coding, but they do not contradict the documented features outright. Missing for 10: proactive AI category/memo suggestions, duplicate detection, fraud/anomaly auditing, and recent independent corroboration of extraction and categorization accuracy.
